metadata.description: 15 MiB NPM unpacked-size cap (lowered from 22.5 MiB): the external source maps (about 9 MB, unused at runtime) no longer ship in the tarball (package.json files negation, enforced by packed-runtime-assets), so the pack measures 14,073,766 bytes; the cap keeps about 1.5 MiB of headroom and sits well below the old 23,061,125-byte pack so a regression that re-packs the maps fails
